Rina (docs): Quick pass on Optimize toolkit found a few inconsistencies: quant profile names, a broken batching link, and old SDK snippets. Opening a small PR to fix.
Omar (eng-ml): Which quant names? We've been seeing 'q4f' in logs but docs say 'q4_0'.
Rina (docs): Proposal: canonicalize on 'q4_0' in docs, add a tiny YAML alias mapping and migration note. Also update Python/TS snippets to new client shape.
Jules (devex): I'll swap the Node example to the async iterator stream pattern and add a short note when to use streaming vs sync.
Kai (engineer): Pasting a minimal Python snippet for adaptive batching + prefix cache that can go in the guide:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Summarize briefly', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=80, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(resp.text)
```
Omar (eng-ml): Add a one-liner: quant affects memory/latency tradeoffs, not model accuracy. Also include migration FAQ: "runtime shows q4f -> use q4_0 in toolkit docs".
support-bot: PR 2001 opened by @rina/docs: "optimize: snippet and quant alias cleanup"  CI: docs-lint passed
